build_mdetr_loss: build an MDETRLoss module with soft token loss, box losses, and optional contrastive alignment
MDETRLoss_forward: compute total losses including soft token, L1, GIoU, contrastive alignment, and VQA losses
contrastive_alignment_loss: compute contrastive alignment loss between projected object queries and text tokens
construct_positive_map: construct a boolean positive map linking predicted queries to target tokens by character positions
build_weight_dict: build a loss weight dictionary from argparse args with configurable loss coefficients
